title: Decision 47: spaces in native execution. The native replay backend of spaces (native_session/space.rs), the metered view reads of the substrate (space_store_handle.rs, P5 of design v2) and the conflict keys of space intents (I-11 and the native key).
design: Decision 47 design v2 (.reified-rspaces-work/d47/design-v2.md), sections 4 and 5, and the epoch closure of commit c6cb371ba (a failed space row closes the epoch). The headline ids are the ids of the D47 phase of formal/reified-rspaces-invariant-map.json.
code_base: The items are in the decision 47 commits of this repository. The line numbers are informative. The checker finds each item by its scope and name.

N1.name: native_replay_reproduces_play
N1.statement: Native replay over the journal rows of native play makes the observer calls of play in the order of play, applies the effects of play and ends with the status of play. Play records at most one row for each operation, and one row for each operation when it completes (H24).

N2.name: native_replay_denial_keeps_prefix
N2.statement: When play runs out of phlo at operation k, play keeps the effects of the operations before k and records k + 1 rows, and native replay over those rows ends with the same calls, the same store and OutOfPhlogistons (H25).

N3.name: native_replay_fails_closed
N3.statement: Native replay fails closed before any effect: no ready row ends NotReady with no call, a forged footprint and an outcome that does not fit the staged kind end Mismatch before any call, and a fire whose recorded candidate is another COMM ends Mismatch after its introduction only, with no COMM observation and no effect (H26).

N4.name: view_charge_cache_independent
N4.statement: A view load charges its key and its value only: a hit and a miss load the same value and charge the same amount, so a warm load and a cold load reserve the same work (H27, P5 of design v2).

N5.name: NativeReplayOutcomeEqual
N5.statement: T8: native replay accepts the journal of play, and only it, and then it has the observer calls, the spending, the effects and the status of play, for every transaction of up to three stores and fires, every phlo limit up to 6 and every journal with one tampered well-formed row.

N6.name: NoBlockedReadiness
N6.statement: With an honest journal, no space row finds a predecessor that is not complete: the key [2]||sid (I-11) keeps the transactions of one space in one conflict group in operation order, also without the native key [2, 0].

N7.name: NoDeadlock
N7.statement: Until every intent ends, some intent can step: a space transaction never waits under its stripes (P1), a host operation waits before it takes its stripes (F4), and a failed space row closes the epoch, so no operation waits forever for it, also with a footprint-consistent forged journal.

items.name: NativeSpaceHost
items.role: The native replay host of space transactions over the native replay session.

items.name: apply_op
items.role: Replays one staged operation against its journal row and closes the epoch when it fails, except after a published denial.

items.name: begin_row
items.role: The authority and the journal row of an operation; a row that is not ready fails closed (P1).

items.name: publish_denial
items.role: Publishes a recorded denial and fails the operation as play fails it, with the epoch open.

items.name: check_candidate
items.role: Compares the staged COMM of a fire with the recorded candidate before the COMM is observed.

items.name: apply_produce
items.role: The R4 steps of a staged produce: the row, the footprint, the outcome fit, the observations, the candidate, then the effects of play.

items.name: apply_consume
items.role: The R4 steps of a staged consume.

items.name: NativeViewReads
items.role: The metered reads of native execution: each view load charges its key and its value, the same on a hit and a miss.

items.name: begin_metered
items.role: Begins a transaction whose view loads read through metered reads.

items.name: begin
items.role: Begins a space transaction with the metered reads of native execution, or with plain reads.

items.name: extend_footprint
items.role: The footprint of a space intent: the key [2]||sid, the extra channels and the authority keys (I-11).

items.name: insert_authority
items.role: Adds the native key [2, 0] in native execution (DR-78, DR-79), a second guarantee.
